description_en: Queries agent information from the Agent marketplace for the SDK
kebab_example: aliyun alidns describe-ati-agent-register-info-market --client-token eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cC..... --agent-host example.com --agent-version 5.0.1 --max-results 100 --next-token 4698691 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAtiAgentRegisterInfoMarket

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The endpoint domain name through which the agent provides services externally
parameters.help_zh: Agent 对外提供服务 Endpoint 域名名称
parameters.name: agent_host

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return in this request
parameters.help_zh: 本次请求所返回的最大记录条数
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token for the next query
parameters.name: next_token

AgentId.description_en: The agent ID, which is uniformly assigned by CNNIC after real-name verification. The AgentID serves as the unique identifier that binds the agent to the real-name authenticated registrant
AgentId.description_zh: AgentID，经过CNNIC实名认证后，由CNNIC统一分配。AgentID作为Agent与实名认证注册人绑定的唯一标识

AgentRegisterInfoId.description_en: The agent registration ID. This ID is automatically generated by the Alibaba Cloud ATS platform and is globally unique within the platform. It is automatically generated during the agent registration process. In the multi-step registration process through the API, this ID must be carried throughout all steps to ensure that each step is associated with the same agent and the complete registration process is completed
AgentRegisterInfoId.description_zh: AgentRegisterInfoId Agent注册ID。由阿里云 ATS 平台自动生成，在阿里云 ATS 平台具有全局唯一性。在 Agent 注册过程中自动生成，通过API注册的多步流程中，该 ID 必须全程携带，以确保各步骤关联至同一 Agent，完成完整的注册闭环
